_comment: Wide-viewport gutter overrides, packed by ebtools pack-all (format: ebtools/parsers/gutter_overrides.py).
Authored block ids of the loaded tileset, drawn only in the wide-viewport gutters over tiles that
would otherwise show the block-0 filler, and only while the SNES 256x224 view doesn't reach them.
block_x/block_y are in 32x32-pixel map blocks; blocks is a list of rows.
